name: Quiet Queue
author: Jeremy Longshore
description: Quiet Queue adds a trustworthy focus switch to Omarchy. Start a 25- or 50-minute session, see the countdown in the bar, and return to normal notification delivery when it expires. It uses Omarchy's native Do Not Disturb service: silenced notifications stay in first-party history, and Quiet Queue never reads, uploads, replaces, or discards them. It turns DND off only when it owns the session; existing DND is left alone, and an external change revokes stale ownership. State checks every 5 seconds.
